_comment: Shared starter quest for any noble house. Drop in houses/<house>.json (e.g. corvane.json) to override for a specific house. Placeholders {house} {seat} {region} {dest} {seatHolder} {seatRelation} are filled from the hero at character creation.

hold_seat.title: Take Up Your Seat
hold_seat.desc: You are the last of {house}, and its seat at {seat} lies waiting - and imperiled. Provision yourself at Orlen's Wares, then set out to claim it.
hold_seat.objective: Gear up at Orlen's, then travel to {dest} and take up your seat.

summoned.title: Report Home
summoned.desc: Word has reached you: you are summoned home. {seatHolder} ({seatRelation}) awaits you at {seat}. Buy what you need from Orlen, then make for the seat of {house}.
summoned.objective: Gear up at Orlen's, then travel to {dest} and report to {seatHolder}.
